scope: isolated exploration; no automatic production promotion

status_meanings.implemented: Runnable experiment or measurement infrastructure, not proven device support or benefit
status_meanings.partial: Concrete scoped primitive; remaining work explicitly described

opportunities.title: Retail-device capability fingerprint
opportunities.reason: App auxv, legal affinity, cache topology, firmware, GPU/OpenCL/NNAPI drivers and actual APK hashes.

opportunities.title: Physical-device performance laboratory
opportunities.reason: Bounded plans, raw samples, independent oracles, crash recovery and SHA-256 indexed ZIP exports.

opportunities.title: Workload-sensitive kernel selection and calibration
opportunities.reason: Offline matched-workload analysis identifies candidates. Production dispatch does not automatically adopt unqualified profiles.

opportunities.title: Oryon topology and legal core placement
opportunities.reason: System, one legal CPU and discovered high-capacity cluster. Affinity scopes the calling thread and subsequently created workers, not existing pools.

opportunities.title: ADPF hints for native work
opportunities.reason: Optional ADPF hints on the dedicated native-calling Linux thread; unregistered internal worker TIDs are not claimed as hinted.

opportunities.title: Thermal-aware scheduling
opportunities.reason: Sustained protocol, thermal pause/recovery hysteresis and raw battery/headroom. Production thermal policy remains unqualified.

opportunities.title: Frame pacing and display-rate selection
opportunities.reason: Supported display-mode requests, actual display/vsync and live-render evidence. Swappy is not integrated.

opportunities.title: CPU/GPU overlap versus staggered scheduling
opportunities.reason: Equivalent fixed CPU/GPU jobs compared serially and concurrently, with cold end-to-end wall time, component oracles and overlap interval. Production scheduling remains unqualified.

opportunities.title: PGO, ThinLTO and code placement
opportunities.reason: ThinLTO is active. tools/run_research_pgo.sh trains and compares immutable host PGO candidates. No Android PGO or BOLT result.

opportunities.title: Packed-source four-target NEON cache
opportunities.reason: Merged PR245 production cache policy measured at step counts 1/2/4/8/16/32/64.

opportunities.title: Source-count-specialised FP64 kernels
opportunities.reason: Real constant-source loops and explicit three-source FP64 NEON, independently checked.

opportunities.title: NEON register-block width sweep
opportunities.reason: Actual two-lane FP64 NEON vectors with varying numbers of independent vector chains.

opportunities.title: Independent sqrt/divide/FMA latency chains
opportunities.reason: Independent sqrt/divide/FMA chains with actual kernel identity and numerical errors.

opportunities.title: Source-major target tiling
opportunities.reason: Source-major target tiles; source order preserved and scratch/packing charged.

opportunities.title: SoA and AoSoA hot data
opportunities.reason: SoA coordinate arrays and packed source records; canonical world unchanged.

opportunities.title: Symmetric dense force tiling
opportunities.reason: Unique triangular source pairs and deterministic equal/opposite updates.

opportunities.title: Worker-local scratch and deterministic accumulation
opportunities.reason: Independent target slices, fixed source order, deterministic worker comparisons.

opportunities.title: Worker-count and tile-size tuning
opportunities.reason: Per-sweep worker controls and bounded pools retained across one segment; pool construction/join is charged once, affinity inherited and target/source order deterministic.

opportunities.title: PRFM and range prefetch
opportunities.reason: Executable compiler-prefetch distance controls. Explicit RPRFM range-prefetch consumer not implemented.

opportunities.title: SVE and SVE2 FP64
opportunities.reason: Actual predicated SVE FP64 arithmetic probe, app-auxv gated. Full SVE gravity solver not implemented.

opportunities.title: SME and SME2 FP64 matrix assist
opportunities.reason: SME and independent FP64 datatype capabilities recorded. No matrix-assisted gravity kernel.

opportunities.title: MOPS copy and clear
opportunities.reason: Actual libc copy/clear bandwidth controls. Library instruction selection is not assumed to use MOPS.

opportunities.title: LSE/LSE2/RCpc atomics
opportunities.reason: Real contended counters compare memory ordering; no unsafe publication rewrite or assumed LSE/RCpc selection.

opportunities.title: WFxT worker waiting
opportunities.reason: Capability evidence retained; no energy/latency-qualified WFxT waiting consumer.

opportunities.title: CSSC and SVE2 bit permutation
opportunities.reason: Capability evidence retained; no dedicated CSSC or SVE2 bit-permutation consumer.

opportunities.title: FCMA complex arithmetic
opportunities.reason: Actual gated FCMA FP64 complex multiplication with matching ordinary control.

opportunities.title: CRC and cryptographic integrity acceleration
opportunities.reason: Actual scalar/ARM CRC32. APK and export SHA-256 uses the platform provider; CRC is not cryptographic integrity.

opportunities.title: PAuth, BTI and MTE
opportunities.reason: PAuth/BTI/MTE observations only. No instrumented hardening result or speedup claim.

opportunities.title: Page size and allocator behaviour
opportunities.reason: Actual kernel page size recorded. Android ELF/ZIP 16KiB compatibility is verified separately; no forced page-size mode or allocator replacement.

opportunities.title: Vulkan capability and activation ledger
opportunities.reason: Supported/implemented/enabled/executed distinctions, driver identity, limits, memory and fallback reasons.

opportunities.title: Subgroup-cooperative compaction
opportunities.reason: Equivalent visibility and ID oracle, odd dispatch tails and actual subgroup gating.

opportunities.title: Buffer-device-address compaction
opportunities.reason: Real typed physical-address compaction, allocation lifetime and readback validation.

opportunities.title: Descriptor indexing and descriptor buffers
opportunities.reason: Actual fixed-binding versus divergent nonuniform descriptor-array compute with exact output oracle. Descriptor-buffer extension and a complete renderer conversion are not implemented.

opportunities.title: GPU-generated indirect work
opportunities.reason: Real GPU-generated indirect compute dispatch. A complete indirect-draw renderer is not implemented.

opportunities.title: Persistent mapping and Vulkan synchronisation
opportunities.reason: Actual persistent/remapped uploads and sync2 controls, plus merged production lifetime fixes.

opportunities.title: Timeline semaphores and presentation retirement
opportunities.reason: Actual isolated compute timeline completion. WSI remains binary; swapchain-maintenance retirement not implemented.

opportunities.title: Pipeline cache and binary reuse
opportunities.reason: Real serialised pipeline cache reuse. Driver internal cache flushing and pipeline-binary extension not claimed.

opportunities.title: GPU timestamps and calibration
opportunities.reason: Available GPU timestamps, host scopes and live-render calibrated timing fields preserved separately.

opportunities.title: Qualcomm tile memory heap
opportunities.reason: Bounded transient tile-heap counter, same-submission lifetime and CPU readback oracle.

opportunities.title: Qualcomm tile shading
opportunities.reason: Embedded pinned shaders execute ordinary/per-tile offscreen inversion. Whole-frame adoption remains unqualified.

opportunities.title: Qualcomm image processing
opportunities.reason: Actual textureBoxFilterQCOM versus sixteen fetches and independent image oracle. Weighted filters/block matching absent.

opportunities.title: Camera-relative coordinate precision
opportunities.reason: Existing FP64 camera-relative subtraction retained and observable. New high/low split coordinates not implemented.

opportunities.title: Particle LOD and dynamic resolution
opportunities.reason: Existing near/medium/far policies and live capture retained. New calibrated adaptive LOD/dynamic-resolution controller not implemented.

opportunities.title: GPU passive-population calculation
opportunities.reason: Actual isolated GPU passive acceleration with CPU oracle. Live population integration/promotion handoff not implemented.

opportunities.title: GPU FP64 qualification
opportunities.reason: Actual FP64 gravity shader gated by shaderFloat64, with full readback validation.

opportunities.title: OpenCL comparison
opportunities.reason: Actual public OpenCL loader/device qualification and FP32/FP64 GPU kernels; inaccessible runtimes explicitly skip.

opportunities.title: AHardwareBuffer sharing
opportunities.reason: Actual Android BLOB allocation, Vulkan import, CPU unlock fence and foreign ownership transfer with gravity readback oracle. Cross-API OpenCL/NPU zero-copy integration is not implemented.

opportunities.title: Reduced-precision visual work
opportunities.reason: Actual FP16/FP32 visual transforms with measured error; physical state remains FP64.

opportunities.title: Compensated FP64 accumulation
opportunities.reason: Kahan and Neumaier force accumulation with analytic cancellation and scalar controls.

opportunities.title: Reproducible pairwise reductions
opportunities.reason: Fixed binary reduction and deterministic worker target slices; changed rounding measured.

opportunities.title: Error-driven adaptive timesteps
opportunities.reason: Bounded step-doubling with convergence-checked independent reference; adaptive schedule is not asserted globally symplectic.

opportunities.title: Close-encounter refinement
opportunities.reason: Actual global dyadic refinement from crossing/orbital times. Local regularisation and collision resolution not implemented.

opportunities.title: Higher-order symplectic integration
opportunities.reason: Fourth-order Yoshida on conservative collision-free fixtures; convergence and reversal tests.

opportunities.title: Wisdom-Holman style planetary splitting
opportunities.reason: Universal-variable Kepler primitive covers elliptic/parabolic/hyperbolic cases. General planetary Wisdom-Holman mapping not implemented.

opportunities.title: High-order Gauss-Radau reference
opportunities.reason: Actual eight-stage order-15 Radau IIA collocation with bounded solve. This is not an IAS15 port.

opportunities.title: 1PN, J2 and radiation force models
opportunities.reason: Synthetic fixed-primary force models, velocity-aware RK4 and same-law fine reference; explicit applicability limits.

opportunities.title: Barnes-Hut and FMM
opportunities.reason: Actual bounded source octree and target-containing aggregate rejection, with error measurement. FMM not implemented.

opportunities.title: Reciprocal-square-root refinement
opportunities.reason: FP32 seed plus FP64 Newton corrections; no unverified hardware-estimate instruction claim.

opportunities.title: Passive acceleration/jerk extrapolation
opportunities.reason: Massive sources remain exact; passive acceleration/jerk predictions checked against FP64 segment checkpoints.

opportunities.title: Mixed-precision forecasts and checkpoints
opportunities.reason: CPU FP32 forecast and separate actual GPU force probe, both FP64-checked. Live GPU forecast/checkpoint handoff absent.

opportunities.title: Hexagon/NPU surrogate experiments
opportunities.reason: Explicit public NNAPI accelerator dense layer versus FP64, no CPU fallback. No trained orbit model or private QNN access.
